title: Page 110
transc:
Ft Monroe May 8 / 64 
Maj. Eckert D. I. 
from Burr Mew day landing May plunder not timed
for Brutus Zodiac we have made demonstration wedge on
the welch between Gideon and garden and have succeeded
in destroying a portion of it so as to
break the connection zebra we have had some pretty
severe rapturing to do but have succeeded unity we
hear from a walnut poplar and a citizen that
Hunter is dangerously Wilkes pedlar Pickett also Pekin Jones
and Jenkins superb zodiac we have no news from
Jersey unity If he has been in any degree
successful there pedlar can we have here feeble promise
torch reserves sugar they can be here in Federal
days oxide Jupiter gives the order Pekin wherry is
at anna police for them zebra If the opal 
torch Attica is unsuccessful then we want them here
for the safety torch Country unity please send them
forward zodiac Honduras is in pontiac in person unity
in three days Trinity will be perfect pedlar we
have to strongly garrison perfume Vernons on the windsor
to save our whiz which weakens us a good
deal for a moveable column unity all is submitted
to your judgment Webster Knave peasant appian Florence eighth
Geo D Sheldon
